senses.gloss:
केश केश, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. क्लिश्),
the hair of the head; the mane (of a horse or lion);
a kind of perfume [cf. ह्रीवेर]; an epithet of
Varuṇa; of Viṣṇu; N. of a Daitya; (ई), f. a lock
of hair on the crown of the head; N. of several
plants, the Indigo plant; another plant, Carpopogon
Pruriens; an epithet of the goddess Durgā.
—केश-
कर्मन्, अ, n. dressing or arranging the air of the
head.
—केश-कलाप, अस्, m. a mass or quantity of
hair, a head of hair.
—केश-कार, अस्, m. a sort of
sugar-cane.
—केश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, dressing or ar-
ranging the hair of the head.
—केश-कीट, अस्, m. a
louse or other insect in the hair.
—केश-गर्भ, अस्,
m. a braid or tress of hair; an epithet of Varuṇa.
—केश-गर्भक, अस्, m. a braid or tress of hair.
—केश-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, pulled or seized by the
hair.
—केश-ग्रह, अस्, m. or केश-ग्रहण, अम्,
n. pulling the hair.
—केश-घ्न, अम्, n. morbid
baldness, falling of the hair.
—केश-चूड, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who has dressed his hair in a tuft or top-
knot.
—केश-च्छिद्, त्, m. a hair-dresser, a barber.
—केश-जाह, अम्, n. the root of the hair.
—केश-
दृंहण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. serving for fastening the
hair.
—केश-धर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
—केश-धृत्, त्, f., N. of a plant, the root of sweet
flag.
—केश-पक्ष, अस्, m. much or ornamented
hair, a tuft.
—केश-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. a row or line of
hair; a quantity of hair.
—केश-पर्णी, f. the plant
Achyranthes Aspera; also अपामार्ग.
—केश-पाश,
अस्, m. much or ornamented hair, a tuft; (ई), f. a
lock of hair hanging down from the top of the head.
—केश-बन्ध, अस्, m. a hair-band.
—केश-भू,
ऊस्, m. the head.
—केश-भूमि, इस्, f. any place on
which hair grows.
—केश-मार्जक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?)
a comb.
—केश-मार्जन, अम्, n. a comb; cleaning
the hair.
—केश-मुष्टि, इस्, m. a handful of hair; N.
of two plants, (also विष-मुष्टि and महा-निम्ब.)
—केश-रचना, f. arranging or dressing the hair.
—केश-रञ्जन or केश-राज, अस्, m., N. of a
vegetable, = भृङ्ग-राज.
—केश-रुहा, f., N. of a
plant, = भद्र-दन्तिका.
—केश-रूपा, f., N. of a
parasitical plant.
—केश-लुञ्चक, अस्, आ, अम्, pulling
the hair.
—केश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a fine head
of hair; having long hair; having a mane.
—केश-
वपनीय, अस्, m., N. of a festival.
—केश-वर्-
धन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. causing the hair to grow.
—केश-वर्धिनी, f., N. of a plant, a kind of Sida.
—केश-वेश, अस्, m. a tress or fillet of hair.
—केश-
[]
वेष्ट, अस्, m. the parting of the hair.
—केश-
हन्त्री, f., N. of a tree, = शमी.
—केश-हस्त, अस्,
m. much or ornamented hair, a tuft.
—केशा-केशि,
ind. hair to hair, head to head; pulling each other's
hair.
—केशाग्र (˚श-अग्˚), अम्, n. the top of a hair.
—केशान्त (˚श-अन्˚), अस्, m. the tip or end of a
hair; long hair hanging down, a lock of hair, a
tuft; cutting off the hair finally, as a religious cere-
mony performed upon Brāhmans at sixteen years of
age, Kṣatriyas at twenty-two, and Vaiśyas at twenty-
four.
—केशान्तिक, अस्, आ, अम्, extending to the end
of the hair as far as the forehead; relating to the
ceremony of final tonsure.
—केशारि (˚श-अरि), इस्,
m. the plant Mesua Ferrea.
—केशारुहा (˚श-आर्˚),
f., N. of a plant, = सह-देवी.
—केशार्हा (˚श-अर्˚),
f., N. of a plant, = महानीली.
—केशावमर्षण
(˚श-अव्˚), अम्, n. pulling the hair, especially amo-
rously playing with it, rubbing it, &c.
—केशोच्चय
(˚श-उच्˚), अस्, m. much or handsome hair.

केशक, अस्, आ, अम्, skilful in dressing hair, be-
stowing care upon the hair.

केशव, अस्, आ, अम्, having long or much or hand-
some hair; (अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa;
N. of the author of a lexicon called Kalpa-dru; the
author of the Dvaita-pariśiṣṭa; the father of Govinda
and Rucikara; N. of the father of Brāhma and uncle
of Maheśvara; N. of the son of Viśvadhara and
brother of Karinātha; N. of the father of Vopadeva;
N. of a plant, = पुन्नाग.
—केशव-जातक-पद्-
धत्य्-उदाहरण, अम्, n. a commentary by Viś-
vanātha on the work Jātaka-paddhati.
—केशव-जी-
नन्द-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of an author.
—केशव-
दास, अस्, m., N. of an author.
—केशव-दैवज्ञ,
अस्, m., N. of an astronomer.
—केशव-भक्ति, इस्,
f. devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
—केशव-मिश्र, अस्, m., N.
of an author.
—केशव-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a
grammarian.
—केशवायुध (˚व-आय्˚), अस्, m. the
Mango tree; any of Kṛṣṇa's weapons.
—केशवार्क
(˚व-अर्˚), अस्, m., N. of the author of the poem
Kṛṣṇa-krīḍita, a son of Jayāditya and grandson of
Rāṇiga; N. of the author of a work called Jātaka-
paddhati; N. of the author of a work called Vivāha-
vṛndāvana
—केशवालय (˚व-आल्˚) or केशवा-
वाल (?) or केशवावास (˚व-आव्˚), अस्, m. the holy
fig tree, Ficus Religiosa.
केशि, इस्, m., N. of an Asura; [cf. केशिन्.]

केशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having fine or luxuriant hair,
relating to the hair; (आ), f. the plant Asparagus
Racemosus.

केशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having fine or long hair, having
a mane; epithet of Indra's and Agni's horses;
epithet of Rudra; (ई), m. a lion; N. of a race; N.
of an Asura slain by Kṛṣṇa; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa;
N. of a son of Vasu-deva and Kauśalyā; (इनी), f. the
plant Chrysopogon Aciculatus; another plant, Nar-
dostachys Jaṭāmāṃsī; an epithet of the goddess
Durgā; N. of an Apsaras; N. of a daughter of the
king of Vidarbha, wife of Sagara and mother of
Asamañja; N. of the wife of Ājamīḍha (Suhotra)
and mother of Jahnu; N. of the wife of Viśravas
and mother of Rāvaṇa and Kumbhakarṇa; N. of a
Rākṣasī; N. of a servant of Damayantī.
—केशि-
निसूदन or केशि-मथन or केशि-सूदन, अस्, m.
or केशि-हन्, आ, m. &c. epithet of Kṛṣṇa the slayer
of the Asura Keśin.

केश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in or on the hair; suit-
able to the hair; (अस्), m., N. of a plant; (अम्), n.
black Aloe wood.

केशारुका केशारुका, f. = कशेरुका, the
back-bone.

केसर केसर or केशर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (the
former form being more usual in Vedic and the latter
in classical literature), the hair; the mane (of a
horse or lion); the filament of a lotus or of any
vegetable; a fibre (as of a Mango fruit); (अम्), n.
[]
the tail of the Bos Grunniens, used as a fan for
driving away flies; (अस्), m., N. of several plants,
Rottleria Tinctoria; Mimusops Elengi; Mesua Ferrea;
(अम्), n. the flower of these plants; gold; sulphate
of iron; N. of a metre consisting of four lines of
eighteen syllables each; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. Asa
Fœtida; [cf. Lat. cœsaries; Angl. Sax. haer;
Eng. hair; Germ. Haar.]
—केसर-ग्राम, अस्,
m., N. of a Grāma.
—केसर-प्राबन्धा, f., Ved.,
N. of a woman.
—केसर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
a mane.
—केसर-वर, अम्, n. saffron.
—केसरा-
चल (˚र-अच्˚), अस्, m. ‘the filament mountain,’ N. of
the mountains situated round Meru, which is called
‘the seed-vessel of the earth.’
—केसराम्ल (˚र-
अम्˚), अस्, m. the citron.
केसरि, इस्, m., N. of the father of Hanumat.

केसरिन् and केशरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a mane;
(ई), m. a lion; a horse; N. of several plants, Rottle-
ria Tinctoria; Mesua Ferrea; a citron tree; a variety
of Moringa with red flowers (= रक्त-शिग्रु); N.
of a man; of a monkey, husband of the mother of
Hanumat.
—केसरि-सुत, अस्, m., N. of Hanumat.
